author: Lon.TV
description:
Find one at ModRetro - https://lon.tv/6ch5p (compensated affiliate link) - ModRetro's M64 is an FPGA recreation of the Nintendo 64. It costs a little less than the competing Analogue 3D and has some good future potential. See more Retro - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLCZHp4d1HnIswkmY7xCvaH3K_78rUsEIO and subscribe to my email list! http://lon.tv/email

One note - I mention at the beginning it doesn't upscale the video - it does but it doesn't enhance it in ways that the Analogue 3D does at the moment.

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVmzoAkKe7JQ
